entities.summary: Ermanno Cressoni was an Italian car designer who worked for both Alfa Romeo and Fiat during his career. He designed or directed the design of a number of significant cars, such as the Alfa Romeo 75 and the Fiat Coupe. He was often referred to as 'Arch'. He died in Milan, Italy in June 2005, after battling cancer for over a year.
